background: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: widescreen 16:9 main-menu background for Lost Zone, a grounded Eastern European exclusion-zone survival game. Create a restrained, realistic painterly game illustration, the visual mood of early STALKER loading-screen art. A small warm lamp inside the workshop provides a quiet amber accent. Wide camera at eye level, physically consistent architecture and restrained natural textures. The left third is calm shadowed vegetation and plain weathered wall, spacious enough for a menu overlay. Main readable environmental detail is center/right but no oversized focal gimmick. Muted charcoal, desaturated olive and cold grey, tiny amber highlights. Atmospheric depth, controlled contrast, subtle grain, no glossy CGI, no oversharpening, no green night-vision cast, no neon, no fantasy, no people, no text, no logos, no UI, no emblems. Composition complete edge-to-edge, no borders. Landscape 16:9.
